messages:
alex_sales: MedBridge Labs asked if we can run a 3-month sealed POC. Requirements: air-gapped installer, artifacts verifiable against their FIPS HSM root, monthly security bundles, but installs performed only quarterly. Also want standby support during cutover. Thoughts?

nina_se: Feasible. Choices: (A) we ship unsigned artifacts + signing guide for their HSM, (B) we sign and provide attestation, or (C) co-sign. Co-sign gives best auditability but needs CI changes. Which do they prefer?

tom_poc: Delivery options we support: tarball + detached sig, OCI index with cosign attestations, or a signed PKCS7 bundle. Minimal verify snippet we give customers:
```
# verify sha256
sha256sum redwood-sealed-v1.tar.gz
# verify detached ECDSA P-384 sig
openssl dgst -sha256 -verify medbridge_root.pem -signature redwood-sealed-v1.sig redwood-sealed-v1.tar.gz
```
Deltas are possible (<50MB) but increase QA.

claire_infosec: Policy notes: we will never hand over private keys. If we sign, we'll provide signed assertions and a revocation/escrow plan in SOW. Need clarity on whether they require FIPS certification evidence beyond HSM usage. Also confirm telemetry: offline installs default to zero telemetry.

sophie_contracts: Ballpark pricing: one-time packaging & signing integration $15k, POC support standby $5k/month, optional onsite $2k/day. We'll need a short addendum for responsibilities (patching cadence, rollback owner, key escrow).

alex_sales: Disk footprint constraint is <110GB and they insist the deployed model is pinned. Can runtime be locked to manual-update?

tom_poc: Yes, we can pin a quantized model variant and set runtime to manual-update. We'll run a model-size audit to confirm <110GB.

artifact_bot: artifact-uploader: uploaded redwood-sealed-v1 (sha256: c0ffee12345...). Please confirm acceptance test to hand to customer.

alex_sales: OK. Action items: (1) @tom_poc produce install checklist + example manifest by Tue, (2) @claire_infosec confirm needed compliance evidence, (3) @nina_se estimate CI time for co-sign by Fri, (4) @sophie_contracts draft SOW addendum and provisional quote. I'll send a provisional proposal to MedBridge. :white_check_mark:
